descriptions.d24f_record_vector_append_all_80346a04: Appends every 16-byte record (halfword, word, table, float) of the source vector to this vector, growing through allocation 0x80212fd4 with fallback 0x803413d8 when full and releasing old storage via 0x802134fc; record copies install table 0x80410500 then 0x804104c0. Then empties the source vector.
